data.name: Project: Fractunum
data.detailed_description:
Death was meant to be an ending. In Fractunum, it became a wound.

Project: Fractunum is a 2D dark fantasy pixel-art Metroidvania built around atmospheric exploration, precise combat, and a fragmented narrative. Awakened between life and death, you must cross a world broken by a forbidden pursuit of immortality and discover the truth behind your own fractured existence.

THE WORLD THAT REFUSED DEATH

Long ago, the rulers of three realms attempted to break the boundary of death. Their ritual failed, corrupting the natural order and leaving the world scarred. You awaken without a name or memory—neither fully alive nor truly dead. To learn what you have become, you must follow the remnants of their legacy.

EXPLORE A FRACTURED WORLD

Journey through interconnected regions filled with forgotten ruins, hidden paths, deadly creatures, and buried secrets. Gain new abilities, revisit earlier locations, and open routes that were once beyond your reach.

MASTER PRECISE, PUNISHING COMBAT

Study enemy patterns, choose your moment to strike, and survive unforgiving encounters where timing, positioning, and restraint matter as much as aggression.

CONFRONT ANCIENT HORRORS

Face grotesque enemies and formidable bosses shaped by a failed quest for immortality. Each victory draws you deeper into the mystery of the fracture and the powers that created it.

RECLAIM YOUR IDENTITY

Recover fragments of memory and uncover a dark story about mortality, ambition, and the price of refusing death.

A DARK FANTASY IN PIXEL ART

Enter a bleak world brought to life through detailed pixel art, haunting environments, and a brooding atmosphere.

data.short_description: Project: Fractunum is a dark fantasy pixel-art Metroidvania with soulslike combat. Explore a fractured world as a warrior trapped between life and death, face grotesque creatures and ancient rulers, and reclaim the memories that reveal your true identity.
data.supported_languages:
English*, German*, Russian*, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730, AMD Radeon R7 240, or Intel HD Graphics 530
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Target performance: 720p at 30 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti, AMD Radeon R7 360, or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Target performance: 1080p at 60 FPS.
